name: claude-session-replay
description: Find anything you discussed in any past Claude Code session, and turn a session into a self-contained HTML replay or Markdown for docs, demos, code reviews and bug reports.

plugins.name: replayer
plugins.description: Export this session as a self-contained HTML replay with secrets redacted (/replayer:replay). The claude-replay command also searches, lists and exports any past session, at no token cost.
